integrity: The proof is self-contained as to the attachment-to-categorical coupling and the finite-size threshold; an exact finite checker corroborates, but does not replace, the all-size argument.
scientific_limitations: The all-time negative association applies only to positive affine degree kernels with nonnegative slope and to one observation time per distinct vertex.
The nonlinear covariance threshold is confined to the specified first-three-weight family; earliest possible positive covariance at size five is universal for strictly positive degree kernels.
Historical mathematical priority is not exhaustively established; independent validation has not been performed.
title: Affine leaf repulsion and its sharp five-vertex nonlinear boundary
